_comment: Headwind MDM with cloudflared sidecar process; external PostgreSQL required. Update the custom image reference before importing.
name: Headwind MDM (Cloudflare Tunnel)
author: arena@example.invalid
description: Headwind MDM web panel using the upstream container, external PostgreSQL, and an in-container Cloudflare Tunnel.

installation.script:
#!/bin/ash
echo 'This egg runs a prebuilt custom image. Build and publish it as described in the package README.'

variables.name: Public domain
variables.description: Public Headwind hostname without scheme, e.g. mdm.example.com. Configure the Cloudflare Tunnel public hostname to http://localhost:8080.

variables.name: Cloudflare Tunnel token
variables.description: Token copied from the Cloudflare Zero Trust tunnel configuration. Secret value; required to start cloudflared.

variables.name: Database host
variables.description: Reachable PostgreSQL hostname/IP (e.g. the database server's private address).

variables.name: Database username
variables.description: PostgreSQL user with privileges on the Headwind database.

variables.name: SQL protocol for generated links
variables.description: Upstream container default. HTTP is used at the tunnel origin; enable HTTPS redirection at Cloudflare edge. Verify generated links after setup.

variables.name: Headwind variant
variables.description: Upstream variant, normally os for the open-source distribution.

variables.name: Headwind WAR URL
variables.description: Upstream web application artifact URL; review before upgrades.

variables.name: Client version
variables.description: Version seeded in initial database configuration by upstream startup scripts.

variables.name: Admin email
variables.description: Email used in initial Headwind database setup.

variables.name: Shared secret
variables.description: Change from the upstream sample/default before production.

variables.name: Force reconfigure
variables.description: Set true only when intentionally regenerating upstream config files; may overwrite persisted configuration.

variables.name: Install language
variables.description: Upstream initial data language (en or ru).
